coder_notes: Retifanlimab is the only investigational agent (arms A and B). Temozolomide is given in arm B and the standard-of-care arm C but omitted in arm A; its presence/absence is part of the question ('With/Without Temozolomide'), so coded established_therapy_experiment per R2 (alternative reading: soc_backbone in arm B). Carmustine wafers were placed at resection before entry for all participants (not a registered intervention but received by every patient): soc_backbone per C3. Arm C ([OTHER]) is explicitly standard of care and works as the control arm. Note interventions list describes temozolomide as 'Anti-PD-1 Therapy' (registry error) and an outcome mentions nivolumab and ipilimumab (apparent copy error). MSI matched to the PD-1 antibody as a predictive immunotherapy marker; exploratory only.
